SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.PRICE.NY-RES.A' AND period = '2024'
Which New York City agencies publish the most forms in the collection?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE gov = 'NYC' AND agency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many days did an OIRA review take on average in 2023?

SELECT round(avg(date_diff('day', date(substr(cast(date_received AS varchar), 1, 10)), date(substr(cast(date_completed AS varchar), 1, 10)))), 1) AS avg_days FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed WHERE cast(date_completed AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Which kinds of relationship connect one Rhea reaction to another?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_relationships WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many leisure and hospitality jobs were lost in spring 2020, and how many are there now?

SELECT year, period, value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES7000000001' AND ((cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period IN ('M02', 'M04')) OR (cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12')) ORDER BY year, period
Which states have the most hospices listed on Care Compare?
SELECT state, count(DISTINCT cms_certification_number_ccn) AS hospices FROM govblock_health.cc_hospice_provider WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many health-based drinking water violations began in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_health_based_ind = 'Y' AND substr(non_compl_per_begin_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which kinds of Treasury securities carried the highest average interest rate in September 2025?
SELECT security_desc, try_cast(avg_interest_rate_amt AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_treasury.avg_interest_rates WHERE record_date = '2025-09-30' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many FDIC-insured institutions have closed or merged out of existence?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '0'
Which kinds of school received the most NIH money in fiscal 2024?

SELECT ed_inst_type, round(sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double))) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' AND ed_inst_type <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the title of patent US-5153197-A?
SELECT patent_number, title, publication_date FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE patent_number = 'US-5153197-A'
Which hospitals collect the most completed patient surveys?
SELECT facility_name, max(try_cast(number_of_completed_surveys AS double)) AS surveys FROM govblock_health.cc_hcahps_hospital WHERE facility_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of single audits raise doubt about the organisation continuing as a going concern?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_going_concern_included AS varchar), 1, 1)) IN ('Y', 'T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_general
Which kinds of emission sources account for the most reported greenhouse gases in 2023?

SELECT s.subpart_category, sum(try_cast(e.co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e_tons FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission AS e JOIN govblock_environment.ghg_dim_subpart AS s ON try_cast(s.subpart_id AS double) = try_cast(e.sub_part_id AS double) WHERE e.year = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the systematic IUPAC name for vanillin?
SELECT c1 AS iupac_name FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_iupac WHERE c0 = '1183'
Which recalls covered the most vehicles?
SELECT max(mfgname) AS manufacturer, campno, max(compname) AS component, max(try_cast(potaff AS bigint)) AS vehicles FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls GROUP BY campno ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wholesale power contracts did Lakeside Syracuse LLC report?
SELECT count(DISTINCT contract_unique_id) AS contracts FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_contracts WHERE seller_company_name = 'Lakeside Syracuse LLC'
Which states consume the most natural gas?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.NGTCB.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people killed in 2022 crashes were thrown out of their vehicle?
SELECT count(*) AS ejected FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' AND ejection IN ('1', '2', '3')
Which dosage forms are most common among listed drug products?
SELECT dosage_form, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE dosage_form IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many certification marks are on file with the trademark office?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(cert_mark_in AS varchar) = '1'
Which counties' hospitals handled the most discharges in 2016?
SELECT hospital_county, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND hospital_county IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem compounds weigh more than 1,000 daltons?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE try_cast(c2 AS double) > 1000
Which companies supply the most dry cask systems for storing spent nuclear fuel?
Dataset Waste Spent Fuel Storage Dry Cask Query 15
SELECT vendor, count(*) AS installations FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_waste_spent_fuel_storage_dry_cask_query_15 WHERE vendor <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people both lived and worked in Los Angeles County in 2021?

SELECT sum(s000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_od WHERE state = 'ca' AND part = 'main' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2021 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '06037' AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '06037'
Which agencies published the most final rules in the Federal Register in 2023?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE doc_type = '"RULE"' AND issue_date LIKE '"2023-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much more did a pound of ground beef cost in January 2024 than in January 2020?
SELECT year, value AS dollars_per_pound FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU0000703112' AND period = 'M01' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2020', '2024') ORDER BY year
Which kinds of air permits are most common among EPA-tracked facilities?
SELECT caa_permit_types, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL AND caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people does a phase 3 trial enrol on average?
SELECT avg(try_cast(enrollment AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE phases LIKE '%PHASE3%'
Which journals publish the most papers linked to NIH grants?
SELECT journal_title, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_grants.nih_publications GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the clinical toxicity set are approved drugs?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_clintox WHERE fda_approved = 1
Which states generated the most nuclear power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.NUC-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many colleges are in Montgomery, Alabama?
SELECT count(DISTINCT unitid) AS institutions FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd WHERE city = 'MONTGOMERY' AND stabbr = 'AL'
Which hospital stays were most common among Medicare patients in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT drg_desc AS diagnosis_group, sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double)) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did the Harbor Maintenance Trust Fund collect in fiscal 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS receipts FROM govblock_treasury.harbor_maintenance_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc = 'Receipts'
Which contaminants are behind the most drinking water violations?

SELECT r.value_description, count(DISTINCT v.violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement AS v JOIN govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_ref_code_values AS r ON r.value_code = v.contaminant_code AND r.value_type LIKE 'CONTAMINANT%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent rejections cite the Supreme Court's Alice decision?
SELECT count(*) AS rejections FROM govblock_patents.oa_research_rejections WHERE alice_in = '1'
Which industry sectors paid the highest average wages nationwide in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.industry_title, try_cast(q.avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_industry_titles AS t ON t.industry_code = q.industry_code WHERE q.area_fips = 'US000' AND q.agglvl_code = '14' AND q.own_code = '5' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many water system lead results came in above the 0.015 mg/L action level?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_lcr_samples WHERE contaminant_code = 'PB90' AND try_cast(sample_measure AS double) > 0.015
